'''Hua''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when he was stationed the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quartermaster Hua appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Rakata Gear Vendor for the Trooper class, though he was later removed during a reorganization of the gear system.<ref name="TOR" />
